response.text: Let me look at the anomalies.

arguments.sql:
SELECT 'unbal' k, l."JRNL_NO"::text a, sum("DR_AMT")::text b, sum("CR_AMT")::text c FROM "GLJRNL" l GROUP BY l."JRNL_NO" HAVING sum("DR_AMT")<>sum("CR_AMT")
UNION ALL SELECT 'badacct', "JRNL_NO"::text, '['||"ACCT_CD"||']', "DR_AMT"::text||'/'||"CR_AMT"::text FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GLCOA" c WHERE c."ACCT_CD"=l."ACCT_CD")
UNION ALL SELECT 'neginv', "INV_ID"::text, "INV_AMT"::text, "STAT_CD"||' '||"JRNL_NO"::text FROM "APINVH" WHERE "INV_AMT"<=0
UNION ALL SELECT 'payne', p."PAY_ID"::text, p."PAY_AMT"::text, i."INV_AMT"::text FROM "APPAYM" p JOIN "APINVH" i USING("INV_ID") WHERE p."PAY_AMT"<>i."INV_AMT"
UNION ALL SELECT 'outperiod', h."JRNL_NO"::text, h."POST_DT"::text, h."PRD_ID"::text FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" WHERE h."POST_DT" NOT BETWEEN p."STRT_DT" AND p."END_DT"
UNION ALL SELECT 'closedt_type', pg_typeof("CLOSE_DT")::text, coalesce("CLOSE_DT"::text,'<null>'), "PRD_ID"::text FROM "GLPERD" WHERE "PRD_ID">=10
SELECT h."SRC_CD", l."ACCT_CD", count(*) n, sum("DR_AMT") dr, sum("CR_AMT") cr FROM "GLJRNL" l JOIN "GLJRNH" h USING("JRNL_NO") GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT min("INV_DT"),max("INV_DT"),min("INV_AMT"),max("INV_AMT"),min("INV_ID"),max("INV_ID"), (SELECT min("PAY_DT")||'-'||max("PAY_DT") FROM "APPAYM") pd, (SELECT min("POST_DT")||'-'||max("POST_DT") FROM "GLJRNH") jd, (SELECT count(DISTINCT "SRC_REF") FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "SRC_CD"='GL') glusers FROM "APINVH"
